## ASD Essential Eight: Patch applications and Patch operating systems

This workbook measures vulnerability remediation timeframes, exploited vulnerabilities (including CISA KEV and vendor-confirmed exploits), and unsupported software or operating systems using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management tables (`DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities`, `DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilitiesKB`, `DeviceTvmSoftwareInventory`, `DeviceInfo` and `IntuneDevices`).

**ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model (November 2023) timeframes:**
- **48 hours**: Critical or actively exploited vulnerabilities in online services, internet-facing OS, core user applications (browsers, Office, PDF, email clients, security software), and at ML3 all applications and operating systems.
- **2 weeks (14 days)**: Non-critical vulnerabilities in core applications (ML1 to ML3), internet-facing OS (ML2 to ML3), and all other applications and OS (ML3).
- **1 month (30 days)**: Non-critical vulnerabilities in other applications (ML2) and non-internet-facing workstation/server OS (ML1 to ML2).

> **Disclaimer:** Independent community workbook. Not produced, endorsed or supported by ASD, ACSC or Microsoft. Indicative telemetry only; refer to the [ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model](https://www.cyber.gov.au/resources-business-and-government/essential-cyber-security/essential-eight/essential-eight-maturity-model).

parameters.name: DeviceGroup
parameters.label: Device group
parameters.query:
DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| distinct GroupName
| order by GroupName asc

content.title: Patch SLA overdue summary (filtered by device group and target ML)

content.query:
let latestDevices = DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup, IsInternetFacing, OSPlatform) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| where ('*' in ({DeviceGroup}) or GroupName in ({DeviceGroup}))
| where ('{ExposureFilter}' == 'All' or ('{ExposureFilter}' == 'InternetFacing' and IsInternetFacing == true) or ('{ExposureFilter}' == 'InternalOnly' and IsInternetFacing != true));
let kb = DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilitiesKB
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, PublishedDate, IsExploitAvailable, CvssScore) by CveId;
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate, CveTags) by DeviceId, DeviceName, CveId
| join kind=inner latestDevices on DeviceId
| join kind=leftouter kb on CveId
| extend AgeHours = datetime_diff('hour', now(), coalesce(PublishedDate, TimeGenerated))
| extend IsExploited = (IsExploitAvailable == true or tostring(CveTags) has_any ('ZeroDay', 'ExploitInTheWild', 'CISA_KEV'))
| where IsExploited or VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == 'Critical'
| extend SlaStatus = iff(AgeHours > 48, 'Breached (>48h)', 'Within 48h')
| summarize AffectedDevices = dcount(DeviceId), MaxAgeHours = max(AgeHours), DeviceGroups = make_set(GroupName, 10) by CveId, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, IsExploited, SlaStatus, RecommendedSecurityUpdate
| order by MaxAgeHours desc, AffectedDevices desc
| take 100
content.title: Exploited (CISA KEV / vendor exploited) and Critical vulnerabilities against 48-hour SLA

content.query:
let latestDevices = DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup, IsInternetFacing, OSPlatform) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| where ('*' in ({DeviceGroup}) or GroupName in ({DeviceGroup}))
| where ('{ExposureFilter}' == 'All' or ('{ExposureFilter}' == 'InternetFacing' and IsInternetFacing == true) or ('{ExposureFilter}' == 'InternalOnly' and IsInternetFacing != true));
let kb = DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilitiesKB
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, PublishedDate, IsExploitAvailable) by CveId;
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, SoftwareName, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, CveTags) by DeviceId, CveId
| join kind=inner latestDevices on DeviceId
| join kind=leftouter kb on CveId
| extend AgeDays = round(datetime_diff('hour', now(), coalesce(PublishedDate, TimeGenerated)) / 24.0, 1)
| extend IsOS = (SoftwareName has_any ('windows', 'ubuntu', 'rhel', 'debian', 'centos', 'macos', 'linux_kernel', 'server'))
| extend IsCoreApp = (not(IsOS) and (SoftwareName has_any ('chrome', 'edge', 'firefox', 'safari', 'office', 'word', 'excel', 'outlook', 'acrobat', 'reader', 'foxit', 'defender', 'zoom', 'teams')))
| extend Category = case(IsOS, 'Operating Systems', IsCoreApp, 'Core Applications', 'Other Applications')
| extend AgeBucket = case(AgeDays <= 2, '0-48h', AgeDays <= 14, '2-14d', AgeDays <= 30, '15-30d', '>30d')
| summarize Findings = count() by GroupName, Category, AgeBucket
| order by GroupName asc, Category asc
content.title: Vulnerability age distribution by device group and Essential Eight category

content.query:
let latestDevices = DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup, IsInternetFacing, OSPlatform, OSVersion, OSVersionInfo) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| where ('*' in ({DeviceGroup}) or GroupName in ({DeviceGroup}));
DeviceTvmSoftwareInventory
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EndOfSupportStatus == 'True' or (isnotnull(EndOfSupportDate) and EndOfSupportDate < now())
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, EndOfSupportStatus, EndOfSupportDate) by DeviceId, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion
| join kind=inner latestDevices on DeviceId
| summarize AffectedDevices = dcount(DeviceId), DeviceGroups = make_set(GroupName, 10) by SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion, EndOfSupportDate
| order by AffectedDevices desc
| take 100
content.title: Unsupported / end-of-life applications (E8-PA-ML1-03)

content.query:
DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup, IsInternetFacing, OSPlatform, OSVersion, OSBuild, OSVersionInfo) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| where ('*' in ({DeviceGroup}) or GroupName in ({DeviceGroup}))
| extend IsUnsupportedOS = (
    OSPlatform in~ ('Windows7', 'Windows8', 'Windows81', 'WindowsXP', 'WindowsVista', 'WindowsServer2008', 'WindowsServer2008R2', 'WindowsServer2012', 'WindowsServer2012R2')
    or (OSPlatform =~ 'Windows10' and toint(OSBuild) < 19045)
    or (OSPlatform =~ 'Windows11' and toint(OSBuild) < 22631)
    or OSVersionInfo has_any ('EndOfLife', 'Unsupported')
)
| where IsUnsupportedOS == true
| summarize DeviceCount = dcount(DeviceId), InternetFacingCount = dcountif(DeviceId, IsInternetFacing == true), SampleDevices = make_set(DeviceName, 10) by GroupName, OSPlatform, OSVersion, OSBuild
| order by DeviceCount desc
content.title: Unsupported / end-of-life operating systems (E8-POS-ML1-03)
